production_browser.surface: actual production atlas map and graph
checks: Map badge absent; source and central workbook links identify total-catch calculations.
Map and graph URL handoff preserves model, method, scope, catch basis, sensitivity, NPP and unidentified settings.
All catch and discards use separate values; sensitivity disabled and no range in both views.
Landings sensitivity show/hide updates the actual map and graph.
Bay 2019 GE ratio: landings 68.562%, all catch 71.311%, discards 2.7487%; landings range 68.562–69.865%.
Bay 2019 model-TL reference: 42.26% landings and unassessed invariant benchmark.
Bay 2007 ratio uses matching annual NPP; all supported history visible in the graph.
1950 observed NPP unavailable; earliest proxy uses labeled 1998 source and gives 9.3261% GE ratio.
Missing NPP retains carbon endpoints; graph download enabled even for a selection containing only unavailable ratios.
Inner scope and zero unidentified treatment update values and range; normalized comparisons suppress routing bands.
Desktop screenshots inspected for map and graph; no console warnings/errors observed.
production_browser.download_validation: Actual button enabled; CSV content and callback behavior verified by JavaScript regression tests. No claim of inspecting an OS-downloaded file.
